source: WOA Story Universe Baseline v1.0; 17-chapter storyboard outline (working structure)

opening_arc.description: The opening story experienced from the scrapyard through Manchester, crew, music and onward investigation.

larger_mystery_arc.description: The full circular narrative; chapters 1–5 form its opening.

chapters.title: The Morning After
chapters.audience_function: Begin at The High Scraparral; establish scrapyard awakening and start the mystery.

chapters.title: Manchester
chapters.audience_function: Music, people, places and fragments begin triggering recognition.

chapters.title: The Crew
chapters.audience_function: Arthur, Brian, Edwin and Nigel become increasingly important to reconstructing what happened.

chapters.title: The Music
chapters.audience_function: Music and equipment begin unlocking deeper memories.

chapters.title: Onwards
chapters.audience_function: The gang moves beyond Manchester and the investigation broadens.

chapters.title: The Photograph
chapters.audience_function: Something physical appears to predate the existence they think they know.

chapters.title: The Artist
chapters.audience_function: DTR and the historical artwork become relevant.

chapters.title: The Worms
chapters.audience_function: They encounter older drawings and records that somehow depict them.

chapters.title: The Story of DTR
chapters.audience_function: The deeper history begins to emerge.

chapters.title: The Abduction
chapters.audience_function: The Botanists and hyperspace explanation finally appears.

chapters.title: The Crop Circle
chapters.audience_function: The audience sees the actual beginning.

chapters.title: The Names
chapters.audience_function: We witness the gang becoming the gang.

chapters.title: The Festival
chapters.audience_function: They discover the festival exactly as described in the origin story.

chapters.title: The Heavy Night
chapters.audience_function: The events that eventually lead to the scrapyard occur.

chapters.title: The Scrapyard
chapters.audience_function: The narrative arrives back at the beginning the audience has already experienced.

policy: Chapter counts are data, not constants in code.
CH01–CH05 are baseline-confirmed summaries; CH06–CH17 are outline-level summaries requiring further development.
Do not fabricate scenes, dialogue, dates or detailed beats from chapter summaries.
The circular structure is a narrative loop, not a time loop.
